name: dm-screen
description: Prepare NPCs and run tabletop RPG encounters with maps, fog of war, reveals and combat turns on dm-screen.com.

interface.longDescription:
Prepare your next D&D session or run an encounter on dm-screen.com. Give an NPC a secret DM note, set up a portrait that changes when Poisoned, or put the party in initiative order. At the table, uncover the entrance room on a battle map, show a dragon on the player screen, add an applause clip to your soundboard, or roll dice on the live table overlay. Owners can inspect the map artwork and fog. Players can use beta map controls to place a claimed character or attach a spell area when the DM allows it.

Connect your dm-screen.com account and select the campaigns the assistant can use. Read, Write and Maintain access work alongside each campaign role. The tabletop display runs in the dm-screen.com web app on your TV, projector or player screen. The plugin can import supported files you attach in ChatGPT, including generated images when your client provides a file reference.
defaultPrompt: Prepare the NPCs for the next session.
Activate the game map and remove fog of war in the first room.
Show a reveal image of the Elder Red Dragon.

prompts: Prepare the NPCs for the next session.
Activate the game map and remove fog of war in the first room.
Show a reveal image of the Elder Red Dragon.

positive.description: Use a disposable owner campaign named Plugin Review with a fully fogged still map named Entry Hall, a named Entrance rectangle enclosing the first room, and another room under fog. Use a Write or Maintain connection.
positive.prompt: Activate Entry Hall in Plugin Review and remove the fog of war in the first room, marked Entrance.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the saved Entrance bounds and snapshot. Activate Entry Hall and uncover just that room. Verify the selected map and that the next room remains covered in the sample game screen.

positive.description: As the review owner, use Plugin Review with no existing Lantern Keeper character.
positive.prompt: Add a hidden NPC called Lantern Keeper to Plugin Review, with the private DM note Collects old keys.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one character with name Lantern Keeper, npc=true, hidden=true and dm_notes containing Collects old keys. Generate a portrait, import it and attach it to the returned character ID. Do not change combat or turns; check existing records before retrying.

positive.description: As the review owner, attach a harmless PNG from the reviewer sample files. Mira First Portrait Review must exist in Plugin Review with no portraits. Credentials and sample access instructions are supplied privately. The recorded fixture now has its first portrait; before rerunning, prepare a fresh portrait-free sample character and provide its exact name. Do not delete existing portraits automatically.
positive.prompt: Add this as Mira First Portrait Review's portrait in Plugin Review. I understand the first portrait becomes the default.
positive.tools_triggered: list_campaigns, list_characters, get_character, list_portraits, import_upload, add_portrait
positive.expected_behavior: Import the actual conversation file and use its returned signed_id as avatar for the returned Mira First Portrait Review character ID. Verify the saved portrait and first-default effect; do not change unrelated portraits.

positive.description: Use the review owner account and a host that can generate an image and pass it as a conversation file. Start with no Elder Red Dragon reveal and open the sample game screen.
positive.prompt: Generate an image of an Elder Red Dragon, save it as Elder Red Dragon in Plugin Review, and show it on our game screen.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the host-generated file reference and returned signed ID. Save one reveal, then select its returned ID for display. Verify the dragon on the sample screen. If the host cannot supply the file, ask for an attachment and record that limitation.

positive.description: As the review owner, attach a harmless map PNG from the reviewer sample files. No Review Crypt map should already exist.
positive.prompt: Add this map as Review Crypt in Plugin Review. Keep it off the game screen.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the imported signed_id as image and the returned campaign ID. Verify the saved map is named Review Crypt, the tool reports active=false, and the map starts fully fogged in the editor.

negative.description: Layered Photoshop export is unavailable. Explain which map edits are available and leave the canvas as it is.
negative.prompt: Export my battle map and its fog layers as an editable Photoshop PSD.

negative.description: The TV browser controls its own tabs and audio permissions. Explain how to open the game screen on the TV and enable audio there.
negative.prompt: Open a new browser tab on my TV and give it permission to play audio.

negative.description: The integration cannot purchase subscriptions or process payments. Explain that purchases require the website. Do not call any dm-screen tool or claim a purchase succeeded.
negative.prompt: Buy me a paid dm-screen subscription using my saved payment card.

review.commerce_description: DM Screen offers a free tier and paid subscriptions for users who need allowances beyond free-tier limits. Users purchase subscriptions on the dm-screen.com website through Stripe-hosted checkout; paulides.dev is the seller. The plugin does not collect payment details or execute purchases.

publication.release_notes: Adds eleven tabletop skills alongside onboarding. Prepare NPCs, assign conditions, manage avatars and automations, run combat, roll dice on the live overlay, upload and show reveals, manage soundboard clips, and move tokens with beta map controls.
